reconcile.note: Keil & Delitzsch propose Abiathar himself later had a son also named Ahimelech, so both genealogical statements describe different generations correctly.

sides.snippet: One of the sons of Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.
sides.verseText: One of the sons of Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.

sides.snippet: and Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were priests; and Seraiah was scribe;
sides.verseText: and Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were priests; and Seraiah was scribe;
